chronology_note: This prospective rule was frozen before accepting the current registry membership changes or rebuilding registry-dependent cohorts and results, and it has now been applied to and reproduced for that revision. It does not claim that the historical 184-proposal registry was generated by this rule.
clarification_note: On 2026-07-17, non-semantic wording and schema clarifications separated the 576 observable-candidate counts from the 610 full-ledger counts and made the already-applied basket and form limits explicit. No recall regex, row decision, active membership, or stage assignment changed.

recall_rule.description: Scan every source row. A numeric HS6 becomes an observable candidate for a chain if and only if its official BACI HS92 description matches that chain's frozen focal lexicon. Existing proposal membership, trade flows, model outcomes, commercial likelihood, and external product knowledge are not recall signals.
recall_rule.scope_limit: This is exhaustive application of a frozen regex rule to the source dictionary, not proof that the lexicon contains every possible synonym and not manual review of all 5022 source rows.

completeness_evidence.interpretation: The frozen negative controls empirically test specified synonym and spelling-variant challenges. Passing them supports, but does not prove, lexicon completeness.

legacy_carryover.purpose: Preserve the provenance of every historical proposal even when its description lacks a frozen focal term.
legacy_carryover.decision_constraint: A legacy-only record cannot be included unless its official description independently satisfies the same focal-term and stage-fit rules. Under the frozen lexicons these 34 records fail focal attribution.

decision_rule.sole_evidence: The official HS92 description distributed in CEPII BACI V202401b.
decision_rule.external_knowledge: May clarify terminology only; it may not supply an absent commodity, material, species, processing form, or end use.
decision_rule.include: The description explicitly identifies the chain's focal commodity, material, or species and the described product form lies inside one frozen declared stage.
decision_rule.commodity_explicit_blend: Include when the focal commodity or material is explicit, regardless of its stated share; attribute the complete published HS6 basket and do not estimate within-code focal share.
decision_rule.commodity_explicit_residual: Include an explicit residual or n.e.s. basket when its product form lies inside a frozen stage; do not claim basket homogeneity.
decision_rule.exclude: Exclude generic, negative, multi-commodity, mixed-species, or unresolved-material descriptions that do not isolate the focal commodity or material.
decision_rule.out_of_stage: Record separately when the focal commodity or material is explicit but the described product form is outside every frozen stage.
decision_rule.classification_order: Apply observable attribution before stage fit. A focal term appearing only as one optional content, one item in a multi-commodity or multi-use list, a negated material, or an end use of a different traded product is exclude, not out_of_stage. Use out_of_stage only after focal attribution of the traded product is resolved.
decision_rule.unresolved_requirement: Zero unresolved records are permitted when the next registry revision is accepted.

frozen_boundary_resolutions.sheep_wool_yarn: Any yarn description that explicitly identifies wool and distinguishes wool from alternative animal fibres is eligible regardless of wool share. 'Wool or fine animal hair' remains unresolved and is excluded.
frozen_boundary_resolutions.sheep_rawskin: A description explicitly identifying a raw sheep or lamb skin or furskin lies inside exp_rawskin whether or not wool is on; tanned or dressed skins are outside that stage.

sheep_wool_form_scope.scope: The frozen wool families cover wool not carded or combed, non-crude wool grease and its derivatives, wool tops and other combed wool, and wool yarn. Crude wool grease and carded-wool fibre are explicit wool products but remain out of stage.
sheep_wool_form_scope.rationale: These are transparent analytical-family limits inherited by the current registry, not claims that crude grease or carded fibre are unrelated to wool and not exclusions based on trade values or model outcomes.

frozen_boundary_resolutions.cotton_yarn: Any non-sewing yarn description that explicitly identifies cotton is inside exp_cottonyarn, regardless of HS chapter, cotton share, or whether another fibre is named first. The stage describes a cotton-explicit yarn basket, not necessarily cotton-primary or pure-cotton yarn.
frozen_boundary_resolutions.cotton_woven_fabric: Any description that itself identifies both a woven-fabric form and cotton is inside exp_cottonfabric, regardless of HS chapter or cotton share. A description saying only fabric, chenille, or gauze does not supply the required woven form and is out_of_stage unless woven is explicit in that official description.
frozen_boundary_resolutions.cotton_knit_fabric: Any knitted- or crocheted-fabric description explicitly of cotton is inside exp_cottonknitfabric.

cotton_apparel_knit.scope: The stage is deliberately limited to the listed product forms, not all Chapter 61 cotton apparel.
cotton_apparel_knit.rationale: A prospective, precision-oriented stage definition that freezes the pre-audit form ontology around representative basic apparel forms whose product form and cotton attribution are explicit in the HS6 description; it is not a claim to recall all cotton apparel and does not use trade values or model outcomes.

cotton_apparel_woven.scope: The stage is deliberately limited to the listed product forms, not all Chapter 62 cotton apparel.
cotton_apparel_woven.rationale: A prospective, precision-oriented stage definition that freezes the pre-audit form ontology around representative basic apparel forms whose product form and cotton attribution are explicit in the HS6 description; it is not a claim to recall all cotton apparel and does not use trade values or model outcomes.

cotton_homewares.scope: Cotton bed linen and cotton kitchen or toilet linen are inside exp_cottonhomewares; table linen, curtains, tents, bags, blankets, and other cotton articles are outside this stage.
cotton_homewares.rationale: A prospective, precision-oriented stage definition that freezes the pre-audit form ontology around bed and kitchen or toilet linen with explicit and stable product forms; it is not a claim to recall all cotton household articles and does not use trade values or model outcomes.

frozen_boundary_resolutions.aluminium_semis_wire: exp_semis_wire covers basic non-stranded aluminium wire. Stranded wire, cables, plaited bands, and finished articles are out of stage.
frozen_boundary_resolutions.aluminium_multi_basket: A basket listing fluoroaluminates alongside fluorosilicates and other complex salts does not isolate aluminium and is excluded. A refractory ceramic basket whose every branch explicitly contains alumina is attributable but out of stage.
frozen_boundary_resolutions.nickel_explicit_alloys: A cross-chapter product form that explicitly identifies nickel, including a copper-nickel or copper-nickel-zinc blend, remains eligible when its form lies inside a declared nickel stage. Chapter placement and material share are not exclusion rules. The stage assignment describes the complete nickel-explicit alloy basket; it does not recast a copper-base alloy as a nickel-only or nickel-base product.

observable_candidate_counts.scope: Only the 576 chain-HS6 records recalled by the frozen observable regexes; excludes the 34 legacy-only provenance records.

full_ledger_counts.scope: All 610 chain-HS6 decision records: 576 observable-regex records plus 34 legacy-only provenance records.

acceptance_gates: 5022/5022 source rows receive the frozen automated regex scan and the source member hash matches; this is not a claim of 5022 manual adjudications
the frozen lexicon negative-control artifact reproduces, with its limitations stated as empirical support rather than proof
34/34 additional legacy-only records retained and adjudicated
610/610 audit-ledger records have a final decision and rationale
every included code maps to exactly one frozen stage within a chain
candidate, decision, stage, and source hashes are regenerated before any registry-dependent cohort or result is accepted
